test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the correct meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

When I was in Class 5, I won the first prize in __extempore__ at my school.

options.text: A short piece of writing on a subject
A speech delivered without prior preparation or rehearsal

solution:
The correct answer is: **A speech delivered without prior preparation or rehearsal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Extempore**: A speech delivered without prior preparation or rehearsal. (**बिना तैयारी के**)

 
 
• **Example**: *The speaker delivered an impressive extempore speech on a topic suggested by the audience.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, the speaker is referring to winning the first prize in an '**extempore**' competition during their time in Class 5.
 
• This indicates that the competition involved speaking or performing without prior preparation, suggesting an impromptu or spontaneous nature.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
